purpose: Name actor-template records selected by the generic type-0x2D interaction path and the type-0x11 collision handler.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_2D_INTERACTION_RESPONSE
templates.selection: Used when the source actor type is not 0x2D; the type-0x2D branch selects ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84 instead.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_11_COLLISION_RESPONSE
templates.post_initialize: Installed after the collision source is cleared and before the response palette upload.

conclusion: Both records have direct named consumers and align exactly with the established 20-byte actor-template cadence. No adjacent record is promoted by association alone.
